in_list.brief: 判断字符串是否命中以 NULL 结尾的字符串表 / Test whether a string appears in a NULL-terminated string table

params.list: 以 `NULL` 结尾的字符串数组 / A `NULL`-terminated array of strings
params.tag: 待查找的字符串 / String to look up

in_list.return: 命中返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when found, otherwise 0
in_list.note: 用于标签集合的成员判定（如 `k_void_tags`、`k_closes_p`）/ Used for tag-set membership tests such as `k_void_tags` and `k_closes_p`

is_heading.brief: 判断标签是否为 `h1`~`h6` / Test whether a tag is `h1` through `h6`
is_heading.return: 是标题标签返回 1 / 1 when the tag is a heading
is_heading.note: 标题之间互相隐式闭合，此判定用于该规则 / Headings implicitly close one another, and this predicate backs that rule

entity_named.brief: 在具名实体表中查找字符实体的 UTF-8 值 / Look up the UTF-8 value of a named character entity

params.name: 实体名，不含前导 `&` 与结尾 `;` / Entity name without the leading `&` or trailing `;`

entity_named.return: 对应的 UTF-8 字节串（静态存储）或 `NULL` / The UTF-8 byte string in static storage, or `NULL`
entity_named.note: 表内覆盖 `amp`、`lt`、`nbsp`、`copy`、`mdash` 等常用实体 / The table covers common entities such as `amp`, `lt`, `nbsp`, `copy` and `mdash`

decode_one_entity.brief: 解码单个 `&...;` 实体 / Decode a single `&...;` entity token

params.s: 指向 `&` 之后、`;` 之前的实体正文 / Entity body after the `&` and before the `;`
params.len: 实体正文加上结尾 `;` 的字节数 / Byte count of the body including the trailing `;`
params.out: out:写入最多 4 字节 UTF-8 的缓冲 / Buffer receiving up to 4 UTF-8 bytes

decode_one_entity.return: 写出的 UTF-8 字节数（1~4），无法识别时 0 / UTF-8 bytes written, 1 to 4, or 0 when unrecognised
decode_one_entity.details: 支持十进制 `{` 与十六进制 `😀` 数字实体，以及 `entity_named` 表中的具名实体。| Numeric forms `{` and `😀` are decoded, as are the named entities in the `entity_named` table.
decode_one_entity.note: 正文长度必须小于 16 且以 `;` 结尾，否则返回 0 / The body must be shorter than 16 bytes and end with `;`, otherwise 0 is returned

decode_entities.brief: 把一段文本里的字符实体全部解码 / Decode every character entity in a text run

params.len: 源文本字节数 / Source byte count
params.out_len: out:解码结果的字节数，可为 `NULL` / Result byte count, may be `NULL`

decode_entities.return: 新分配且以 NUL 结尾的解码文本 / Newly allocated NUL-terminated decoded text
decode_entities.details: 逐字节扫描，遇到 `&` 时按最长 12 字节向前找 `;`，识别则替换、否则原样保留。| Scans byte by byte; on `&` it looks ahead up to 12 bytes for `;` and replaces when recognised, otherwise copies verbatim.
decode_entities.note: 输出缓冲按输入长度 +1 分配，实体替换不会超出该大小 / The output is allocated at the input length plus one, and entity replacement never exceeds it

stack_push.brief: 把节点压入开放元素栈 / Push a node onto the open-element stack

params.st: 开放元素栈 / The open-element stack
params.node: 压入的节点 / Node being pushed

stack_push.note: 按需倍增内部数组容量 / The internal array grows by doubling as needed

current_node.brief: 取得当前的插入位置节点 / Obtain the current insertion point node
current_node.return: 栈顶元素，栈空时返回 `<body>` / The stack top, or the `<body>` element when the stack is empty
current_node.note: 树构建阶段的“当前节点”概念 / The “current node” concept of the tree-construction stage

stack_top.brief: 只看不弹地取得栈顶节点 / Peek at the top node of the stack

params.st: 开放元素栈 / The open-element stack

stack_top.return: 栈顶节点，栈空时 `NULL` / The top node, or `NULL` when the stack is empty

stack_pop_to.brief: 反复弹栈直到指定节点被弹出 / Pop the stack until the given node has been popped

params.node: 目标节点；栈被清空仍未遇到时全部弹出 / Target node, with everything popped when it is never reached

stack_pop_to.note: 该节点自身也会被弹出（含端点）/ The node itself is popped as well (inclusive)

all_whitespace.brief: 判断字符串是否全为空白 / Test whether a string is entirely whitespace
all_whitespace.return: 全为空白（含空串）返回 1 / 1 when every character is whitespace, including the empty string
all_whitespace.note: 空白集合由 `hpe_is_space` 定义 / The whitespace set is defined by `hpe_is_space`

in_table_context.brief: 判断节点是否处于表格插入上下文 / Test whether a node is a table insertion context

params.n: 待检查的节点，可为 `NULL` / Node to inspect, may be `NULL`

in_table_context.return: 是 `table`/`tbody`/`thead`/`tfoot`/`tr` 元素返回 1 / 1 for a `table`, `tbody`, `thead`, `tfoot` or `tr` element
in_table_context.details: 这些节点只接受合法的表格内容，其它文本与元素要被 foster parenting 搬到最近的 `<table>` 之前。| These nodes only accept legal table content, so other text and elements are foster-parented to just before the nearest `<table>`.

allowed_in_table.brief: 判断标签在给定表格上下文中是否合法 / Test whether a tag is legal in a given table context

params.ctx: 表格上下文节点（`table`/`tr`/`tbody` 等）/ Table context node such as `table`, `tr` or `tbody`
params.tag: 待判定的标签名，可为 `NULL` / Tag name to test, may be `NULL`

allowed_in_table.return: 合法返回 1 / 1 when the tag may appear there
allowed_in_table.note: 按上下文选择 `k_in_table` / `k_in_row` / `k_in_section` 三张白名单 / The whitelist is chosen among `k_in_table`, `k_in_row` and `k_in_section` by context

nearest_table.brief: 在开放元素栈上寻找最近的 `<table>` / Find the nearest `<table>` on the open-element stack
nearest_table.return: 最近的 `table` 元素，无则 `NULL` / The nearest `table` element, or `NULL`
nearest_table.note: foster parenting 的插入锚点由它给出 / It provides the insertion anchor for foster parenting

insert_node.brief: 把节点插入到当前插入点，必要时 foster parenting / Insert a node at the current point, foster-parenting when required

params.node: 待插入的节点 / Node to insert
params.tag: 标签名，可为 `NULL`（文本节点）/ Tag name, `NULL` for a text node

insert_node.details: 当当前节点是表格上下文且不接受 `tag` 时，节点被插到最近的 `<table>` 之前，与浏览器的容错行为一致。| When the current node is a table context that does not accept `tag`, the node is placed just before the nearest `<table>`, matching browser fault tolerance.
insert_node.note: 接受时按 `hpe_dom_children_root` 追加到当前节点 / When accepted it is appended through `hpe_dom_children_root` of the current node

add_text.brief: 解码并插入一段文本节点 / Decode and insert a text node

params.begin: 文本起止指针（含）/ Start of the text run, inclusive
params.end: 文本结束指针（不含）/ End of the text run, exclusive

add_text.details: 先做实体解码；`<head>` 内的空白与表格上下文中的纯空白文本被丢弃。| Entities are decoded first; whitespace inside `<head>` and whitespace-only text in a table context are dropped.
add_text.note: 解码结果为空或纯空白（在上述位置）时不插入任何节点 / No node is inserted when the decoded text is empty or whitespace-only in those positions

is_name_char.brief: 判断字符是否可出现在标签/属性名中 / Test whether a character may appear in a tag or attribute name
is_name_char.return: 是名称字符返回 1 / 1 when it is a name character
is_name_char.note: 空白、`>`、`/`、`=` 与 `\0` 都不是名称字符 / Whitespace, `>`, `/`, `=` and `\0` are not name characters

skip_spaces.brief: 跳过解析游标处的连续空白 / Skip consecutive whitespace at the parse cursor
skip_spaces.note: 只前进 `pos`，不修改源文本 / Only advances `pos` and never modifies the source

read_name.brief: 读取并小写化一个标签/属性名 / Read and lowercase a tag or attribute name

params.out: out:接收小写名称的缓冲 / Buffer receiving the lowercased name
params.cap: 输出缓冲容量（字节）/ Capacity of the output buffer in bytes

read_name.return: 读到的名称长度 / Length of the name read
read_name.note: 超出 `cap` 的部分只前进游标不再写入，结果始终以 NUL 结尾 / Characters beyond `cap` advance the cursor without being stored, and the result is always NUL-terminated

skip_to_tag_end.brief: 前进到下一个 `>` 并跳过它 / Advance past the next `>` consuming it
skip_to_tag_end.note: 到达输入末尾时停在末尾，不越界 / Stops at the end of input and never reads past it

find_ci.brief: 在文本中忽略大小写查找子串 / Search a substring case-insensitively

params.hay: 被搜索的文本 / Text being searched
params.hay_len: 被搜索文本长度 / Length of the haystack
params.from: 起始搜索下标 / Index to start searching from
params.needle: 要查找的子串 / Substring to look for

find_ci.return: 首次出现的下标，未找到返回 `(size_t)-1` / Index of the first occurrence, or `(size_t)-1` when absent
find_ci.note: 用于查找 `</script` 等结束标签与注释结束符 / Used to locate end tags such as `</script` and comment terminators

is_head_content.brief: 判断标签是否属于 `<head>` 的合法内容 / Test whether a tag is legal `<head>` content
is_head_content.return: 属于 head 内容返回 1 / 1 when the tag belongs in the head
is_head_content.note: `meta`/`link`/`style`/`title`/`base`/`script`/`template`/`noscript` 视为 head 内容 / `meta`, `link`, `style`, `title`, `base`, `script`, `template` and `noscript` count as head content

is_rawtext.brief: 判断标签是否为原始文本元素 / Test whether a tag is a raw-text element
is_rawtext.note: 原始文本元素内部不做标签解析，直到遇到自己的结束标签 / Their body is not tag-parsed until their own end tag appears

open_select.brief: 寻找最内层仍开放的 `<select>` / Find the innermost still-open `<select>`
open_select.return: 开放中的 `select` 元素，无则 `NULL` / The open `select` element, or `NULL`
open_select.note: 遇到 `table` 或 `template` 即停止搜索，作为 select 作用域边界 / The search stops at `table` or `template`, the select scope boundaries

closes_open_element.brief: 判断起始标签是否隐式闭合当前开放元素 / Test whether a start tag implicitly closes the current open element

params.open_tag: 栈顶当前开放的标签 / Tag currently open at the stack top
params.tag: 即将开始的标签 / Tag that is about to start

closes_open_element.return: 会触发闭合返回 1 / 1 when it triggers a close
closes_open_element.details:
规则由数据表 `k_close_rules` 驱动（`
  • a
  • b`、`

    x

    `、`ab` 等）；标题之间互相闭合。| Rules are driven by the `k_close_rules` table (`
  • a
  • b`, `

    x

    `, `ab`, ...); headings close one another.
closes_open_element.note: 新增容错规则只需改数据表，无需改代码 / Adding a fault-tolerance rule is a data change, not a code change

auto_close_for_start.brief: 为即将开始的标签弹出需要隐式闭合的开放元素 / Pop the elements implicitly closed by an upcoming start tag

params.tag: 即将开始的标签 / Tag that is about to start

auto_close_for_start.note: 至多循环 64 次以防规则异常导致死循环 / Loops at most 64 times to guard against runaway rules

synthesize_table_nodes.brief: 为表格内容补出缺失的 `tbody` / `tr` 元素 / Synthesise missing `tbody` and `tr` elements for table content

params.tag: 即将开始的标签 / Tag that is about to start

synthesize_table_nodes.details: `<table><tr>` 补出 `<tbody>`；`<table><td>` 或 `<tbody><td>` 补出 `<tr>`（必要时先补 `<tbody>`）。补出的元素是合法表格内容，不触发 foster parenting。| `<table><tr>` gains a `<tbody>`; `<table><td>` or `<tbody><td>` gains a `<tr>` (and a `<tbody>` first when needed). The synthesised elements are legal table content and are not foster-parented.
synthesize_table_nodes.note: 仅当栈上存在 `<table>` 时才生效 / It only takes effect when a `<table>` is open on the stack

handle_implied_container.brief: 把 `<html>`/`<head>`/`<body>` 折算进合成骨架 / Fold `<html>`, `<head>` and `<body>` into the synthetic scaffolding

params.node: 已创建的对应元素节点 / The element node that was created for it

handle_implied_container.return: 按这种方式处理掉返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the tag was consumed this way, otherwise 0
handle_implied_container.details: 属性被合并到预建的骨架元素上，`<head>`/`<body>` 还会相应调整开放元素栈。| Attributes are merged onto the pre-built scaffolding elements, and `<head>` or `<body>` also adjust the open-element stack.
handle_implied_container.note: 非这三个标签一律返回 0，交由常规路径处理 / Any other tag returns 0 and goes down the normal path

handle_start_tag.brief: 处理一个起始标签 / Handle a start tag

params.tag: 标签名（已小写）/ Tag name, already lowercased
params.node: 已创建并解析好属性的元素节点 / Element node already created with its attributes parsed
params.self_closing: 自闭合标志（`/>` 为 1）/ Self-closing flag, 1 for `/>`

handle_start_tag.details: 依次执行：折入隐含容器、`<select>` 作用域过滤、body 内容开始时隐式闭合 `</head>`、隐式闭合规则、表格节点补全，最后插入并按需压栈。| In order: fold into implied containers, filter inside `<select>` scope, implicitly close `</head>` when body content starts, apply implicit-closing rules, synthesise table nodes, then insert and push when appropriate.
handle_start_tag.note: 空元素（`k_void_tags` 中的标签）与自闭合标签不压栈 / Void tags (those in `k_void_tags`) and self-closing tags are not pushed

insert_empty_p.brief:
插入一个空 `

` 元素 / Insert an empty `p` element
insert_empty_p.details:
`

` 在没有开放段落时按 HTML 容错规则插入一个空段落。| A `

` with no open paragraph inserts an empty one, per HTML fault tolerance.

handle_end_tag.brief: 处理一个结束标签 / Handle an end tag

params.tag: 标签名（已小写）/ Tag name, already lowercased

handle_end_tag.details:
``/`` 弹空到 ``；`
` 按 `
` 处理；``; otherwise the stack is searched for a matching element and everything above it is popped.
handle_end_tag.note: 找不到匹配元素且标签为 `p` 时补插空段落 / When no element matches and the tag is `p`, an empty paragraph is inserted

parse_attributes.brief: 解析起始标签内的 `name="value"` 属性 / Parse the `name="value"` attributes of a start tag

params.node: 接收属性的元素节点 / Element node receiving the attributes
params.self_closing: out:置 1 表示见到结尾 `/` / Set to 1 when a trailing `/` was seen

parse_attributes.details: 支持双引号、单引号与无引号三种取值形式，属性值经实体解码后写入；读到 `>` 结束。| Quoted (double or single) and unquoted values are supported, each entity-decoded before being stored; parsing ends at `>`.
parse_attributes.note: 同名属性重复出现时后者覆盖前者 / Later duplicates of the same attribute overwrite earlier ones

parse_rawtext_body.brief: 消费 `<style>`/`<script>` 的原始文本直到其结束标签 / Consume the raw body of a `<style>` or `<script>` up to its end tag

params.node: 原始文本所属元素 / Element owning the raw text
params.tag: 元素标签名，用于构造结束标签 / Element tag name, used to build the closing tag

parse_rawtext_body.note: 找不到结束标签时一直消费到输入末尾 / When no end tag is found the rest of the input is consumed

consume_end_tag.brief: 消费一个 `</name ...>` 结束标签并应用 / Consume a `</name ...>` end tag and apply it
consume_end_tag.return: 固定返回 1 表示已读到一个结束标签 / Always 1, reporting that an end tag was read
consume_end_tag.note: 读到名称为空时只前进游标，不触发任何树操作 / An empty name only advances the cursor without any tree action

consume_start_tag.brief: 消费一个 `<name attrs...>` 起始标签或原始文本 / Consume a `<name attrs...>` start tag or raw text
consume_start_tag.return: 固定返回 1 表示已读到一个起始标签 / Always 1, reporting that a start tag was read
consume_start_tag.details: 读取名称与属性；原始文本元素转入 `parse_rawtext_body`，其余交给 `handle_start_tag`。| The name and attributes are read; raw-text elements divert to `parse_rawtext_body`, everything else goes to `handle_start_tag`.
consume_start_tag.note: 孤立 `<` 当作普通文本写入；未被树接纳的节点会被立即释放 / A stray `<` is emitted as text, and a node the tree did not accept is freed immediately

consume_markup_decl.brief: 消费注释、DOCTYPE 或处理指令 / Consume a comment, doctype or processing instruction
consume_markup_decl.details: `<!-- ... -->` 跳到注释结束符；`<!doctype ...>` 与 `<?pi ...>` 跳到下一个 `>`。| `<!-- ... -->` skips to the comment terminator, while `<!doctype ...>` and `<?pi ...>` skip to the next `>`.
consume_markup_decl.note: 这些结构不产生任何 DOM 节点 / None of these constructs produce a DOM node

parser_init.brief: 初始化解析器及其合成骨架 / Initialise the parser and its synthetic scaffolding

params.source: 待解析的 HTML 源文本 / HTML source text to parse
params.length: 源文本字节数 / Source byte count

parser_init.details: 预建 `document → html → head, body` 骨架并把 `<body>` 压入开放元素栈。| Pre-builds the `document` → `html` → `head`, `body` scaffolding and pushes `<body>` onto the open-element stack.

parse_step.brief: 推进解析器一步 / Advance the parser by one step
parse_step.details: 按当前字符分派：普通文本走 `add_text`，`<!`/`<?` 走 `consume_markup_decl`，`</` 走 `consume_end_tag`，其余走 `consume_start_tag`。| Dispatch on the current character: plain text goes to `add_text`, `<!`/`<?` to `consume_markup_decl`, `</` to `consume_end_tag` and anything else to `consume_start_tag`.
parse_step.note: 一次调用至少消费一个字符，因此主循环必然前进 / A call always consumes at least one character, so the main loop always makes progress

hpe_html_parse.brief: 解析本地 HTML 文档为 DOM 树 / Parse a local HTML document into a DOM tree

params.source: HTML 源文本 / HTML source text
params.length: 源文本字节数 / Source byte count

hpe_html_parse.return: 包含 `<html><head></head><body>...</body></html>` 的文档节点 / A document node containing `<html><head></head><body>...</body></html>`
hpe_html_parse.details: 容错解析：隐式闭合、表格节点补全、foster parenting、原始文本与实体解码都在此过程中完成。| Fault-tolerant parsing: implicit closing, table-node synthesis, foster parenting, raw-text handling and entity decoding all happen here.
hpe_html_parse.note: 返回的文档树由调用方用 `hpe_dom_free` 释放 / The caller frees the returned document tree with `hpe_dom_free`
